headline: First time since independence: India's new envoy arrives by road in Bangladesh
summary: High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi makes a historic entry into the country, emphasizing the potential of India-Bangladesh unity as a global force.
details: India's new High Commissioner to Bangladesh, Dinesh Trivedi, has arrived in Dhaka by road, marking the first time a new Indian envoy has entered the country this way since independence.
The journey by road is seen as a symbolic gesture highlighting the close ties and connectivity between the two neighboring nations.
Upon his arrival, Trivedi spoke about the strategic importance of the relationship, stating that if India and Bangladesh unite, they could become a significant global power.
The new envoy's arrival comes at a time when both nations are focusing on strengthening bilateral cooperation across various sectors including trade and diplomacy.
caption:
A historic first! India's new High Commissioner reaches Bangladesh by road for the first time since independence.

India's new High Commissioner to Bangladesh, Dinesh Trivedi, has arrived in Dhaka by road, marking the first time a new Indian envoy has entered the country this way since independence.

The journey by road is seen as a symbolic gesture highlighting the close ties and connectivity between the two neighboring nations.

Upon his arrival, Trivedi spoke about the strategic importance of the relationship, stating that if India and Bangladesh unite, they could become a significant global power.

The new envoy's arrival comes at a time when both nations are focusing on strengthening bilateral cooperation across various sectors including trade and diplomacy.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline_marked: Midnight heist: [[Attorney General's office burgled]] in Dhaka
headline: Midnight heist: Attorney General's office burgled in Dhaka
summary: Attorney General Ruhul Quddus Kajal suspects the theft was a planned attack by disgruntled former employees.
details: A group of intruders broke into the Office of the Attorney General in the Supreme Court area of Dhaka late Thursday night.
The culprits entered by breaking the Thai glass windows in front of the elevators on the ground and first floors around 1:15 AM.
Security guards Fazlul Haque and Mithun Barai, along with on-duty police, chased the intruders, forcing them to flee the scene.
The thieves managed to take one part of the glass structure but were unable to carry away the other.
Attorney General Ruhul Quddus Kajal stated that while it appears to be a simple theft, he believes it was a planned act by a specific group.
Kajal noted that several law officers and employees had recently been dismissed, and another was jailed for corruption.
He believes these individuals may have orchestrated the incident as propaganda against his anti-corruption stance.
Shahbagh Police Station Inspector Jahangir Alam confirmed the investigation is ongoing, though no formal case or General Diary (GD) has been filed yet.
caption:
A midnight break-in at the Office of the Attorney General. Was it a simple theft or a planned conspiracy?

A group of intruders broke into the Office of the Attorney General in the Supreme Court area of Dhaka late Thursday night.

The culprits entered by breaking the Thai glass windows in front of the elevators on the ground and first floors around 1:15 AM.

Security guards Fazlul Haque and Mithun Barai, along with on-duty police, chased the intruders, forcing them to flee the scene.

The thieves managed to take one part of the glass structure but were unable to carry away the other.

Attorney General Ruhul Quddus Kajal stated that while it appears to be a simple theft, he believes it was a planned act by a specific group.

Kajal noted that several law officers and employees had recently been dismissed, and another was jailed for corruption.

He believes these individuals may have orchestrated the incident as propaganda against his anti-corruption stance.

Shahbagh Police Station Inspector Jahangir Alam confirmed the investigation is ongoing, though no formal case or General Diary (GD) has been filed yet.
